adjudication.depicted_input: Bottom CellPuzzles panel showing the batch-level prompt input: cells represented by ranked top-expressed genes, contextual metadata, and candidate cell-type labels supplied to the reasoning model.
adjudication.rationale: The current source figure is defensible because Figure 2 explicitly depicts the route-specific model input for the CellPuzzles/Cell-o1 task. Under the atlas rules, the exact base-model name "o1" does not need to appear when the paper uses the same depicted input mechanism for that variant. A model box is also not required because the crop visibly shows the input representation that the paper states is given to the model. A tighter crop is preferable: it should focus on the bottom input/task region and exclude the unrelated human-expert panel and most of the output area.
